proto.text: Clickable prototype — mock records, state shared across every screen

record.text:
Vehicle record (same shape the Spring Boot API will return)

id · registrationNo (unique) · type · make · model · year · fuel · chassisNo · active · createdAt · updatedAt

Duplicate rule: compare registrationNo uppercased with spaces and hyphens removed, so “dha-metro-ga 11 4582” = “DHA-METRO-GA 11-4582”. Edit skips the vehicle being edited.

v1info.text:
V1 — what's in it

6 screens: Dashboard, Vehicles list, Vehicle detail, Add/edit form, Maintenance, Components sheet.

Good for: the long-term product vision and the shared visual language.

Not covered: login, duplicate-number check, data that persists between screens.

v2info.text:
V2 — what's in it

Scope: Login, app shell, Vehicle List, Register / Edit, Delete, duplicate registration-number validation.

One working prototype: add, edit and delete stay in effect across screens (mock data).

Same colors and components as V1.

Next versions: new page V3, V4… never overwrite an old one.

v3info.text:
V3 — what changed from V2

Same scope and colours as V2. Refined: navigation, table, form spacing, buttons, empty states, loading states, validation messages. See the sheet on the left.

Still mock data, no API calls.

Tweaks on each frame: start screen · data (sample / empty) · loadDelay · primary colour (#5B9BD5 brand / #2E75B6 accessible).

v3title.text: V3 · V2 refined, one component at a time · 21 Nov 2026

v4check.text:
Reachability check (run in code)

Login → Vehicle List (Sign in)
List → Register (button or empty state)
List → Edit (Edit button or vehicle number)
Register / Edit → List (Save, Cancel, breadcrumb)
List → Login (Sign out)

All four core screens reachable.

v4info.text:
V4 — what changed from V3

Vehicle List: number shown as a plate badge, Status moved next to it, Type · Fuel merged, labelled Edit and Delete always visible, first-run empty state lists what you'll need.

Form: Identification (registration + chassis) / Vehicle details (type, make, model, year) / Fuel & status. Chassis now checked when filled. Footer wraps on small screens.

Consistency: every input and secondary button uses the same border, controls line up at 36 or 44 px, one button radius (10), one divider colour.

Business behaviour unchanged.

v4title.text: V4 · Review pass: list, form, consistency · 21 Nov 2026

v5info.text:
V5 — what changed from V4

New Dashboard, built only from vehicle records (no trips, fuel or maintenance data yet):
• Total / Active / Inactive / Needs details (each card opens the matching list or record)
• Vehicles by type, Vehicles by fuel
• Recently updated (opens Edit)
• Needs details: vehicles missing chassis no. or year, with Add details

Sidebar: Dashboard + Vehicles. Sign in now lands on Dashboard.

Everything else is identical to V4. Mock data: two records now have a missing chassis no. or year, to show the Needs details list.

v5title.text: V5 · V4 + Dashboard for the vehicle module · 21 Nov 2026

v6title.text: V6 · Registration number in parts, no Tab or mouse needed · 21 Nov 2026

v6info.text:
V6 — what changed from V5

Registration number is split into Area · Metro · Class · Series · Number.

Just keep typing “dhaga114582”:
• 3 letters fill Area, then the cursor jumps to Class
• typing a digit in Class moves it into Series
• 2 digits fill Series, then the cursor jumps to Number
• Space or “-” also moves to the next part
• Backspace in an empty part goes back and deletes
• ← / → move between parts at the edges
• Pasting “DHA-METRO-GA 11-4582” anywhere fills every part

Metro switches on by itself for metro cities (DHA, CTG, SYL…); tap it to change.
Number pad opens for Series and Number on phones.
Errors name the exact part (“Series needs 2 digits”). Duplicate check unchanged.

Everything else identical to V5.

v7title.text: V7 · Filters, keyboard-only registration, Settings · 21 Nov 2026

v7info.text:
V7 — what changed from V6

Sidebar: + Register vehicle and + Settings. Dashboard, Vehicles and the page buttons all stay.

Vehicle List filters: Vehicle type · Fuel · Last updated · Added (7 / 30 / 90 days, 12 months). Sort by Last updated, Recently added, Oldest added, Number A–Z / Z–A. Active filters turn blue; “Clear filters (n)”.

Keyboard-only registration: the cursor starts in the first box. Enter moves to the next field, finishing the plate jumps to Chassis, ← → pick fuel, Ctrl/⌘+Enter saves, Esc cancels.

Settings: add/remove vehicle types and fuels (a value in use can't be removed), and switch dashboard cards on/off. Dashboard has a Customize button too.

Mock data now has an “added” date.

v8title.text: V8 · Filter button + panel, date calendars, list columns in Settings · 21 Nov 2026

v8info.text:
V8 — what changed from V7

Filters: one small filter button (with a count badge) opens a panel: Vehicle type, Fuel, Make, Last updated on, Added on. Nothing changes until you press Apply filters; Esc or × closes without applying. The panel shows how many vehicles will match. Applied filters show as removable chips above the table.

Dates: each date field opens a small calendar. Only dates that have updated/added vehicles are bold and clickable (blue dot); other days are greyed out. ‹ › jump to the previous/next month that has changes.

Settings › Vehicle list columns: switch each field on/off (Status, Type, Fuel, Make, Model, Year, Chassis no., Added, Last updated). Make / Model / Year that are off show under the vehicle number, as before. Live preview. The list also has a Columns button that jumps there.
